mechanism.productDelta: 208ce122fe mounts a strict tenant-membership check on the Tools router: server/src/routes/tools.routes.ts:10 imports requireActiveTenantMembership and :34 does router.use(requireActiveTenantMembership), between verifyToken (:33) and requireOrgAccess() (:35). Present unchanged at 4f0fd2cd9b.
mechanism.whyItHangs: That middleware is the first consumer of DbPromise on this route (auditsStrictMembership.middleware.ts:30 imports DbPromise; :74 awaits DbPromise.get on organization_members). ToolController reaches persistence only through queryHelpers (ToolController.ts:46), which is the seam the test mocks. DbPromise.ts:14 imports recordQueryPerformance from queryHelpers, but the test's factory mock at tool-session-roundtrip.contract.test.ts:57-65 does not return that export, and Vitest throws on a missing factory export. In the test environment the DB proxy is the in-process mock driver, which invokes its callback synchronously, so inside DbPromise.get the sequence is: clearTimeout (:345), guard.claim() succeeds (:346), recordQueryPerformance throws (:347). The synchronous throw unwinds into the wrapping catch at :361-363, where clearTimeout runs again and guard.claim() now returns false, so the handler returns BEFORE resolve/reject. The promise is left permanently pending with its timeout already cleared, the middleware await never resumes, Express never responds, and supertest waits until the 60s vitest timeout.
mechanism.downstreamSymptom: Because every request now dies in middleware, ToolController is never entered and ensureToolsSchema never runs, so the SQLite-asserting tests fail immediately with "no such table: tool_sessions" / "no such table: tool_initiative_links" and "expected [] to include 'output_json'" rather than timing out. The 481-483s duration is roughly eight timed-out tests at 60s each.
mechanism.measuredDisproofOfSelfHealing: Re-running the first case at 208ce122fe with --testTimeout=25000 still timed out at 25s (27.73s wall), so the promise outlives DbPromise's own 15s DEFAULT_TIMEOUT — consistent only with a permanently unsettled promise whose timer was cleared.
